\section[der Saft]{der Saft — juice}

\label{lesson:GE-C74-saft}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for salt, then the German for sugar.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: der Saft}
\textbf{der Saft} — \textquotedblleft{}juice\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{Saft} $\leftarrow$ Middle High German \emph{saf} — inherited; EtymDB 2.1 lists it beside English \emph{sap}, from Proto-Germanic \emph{*sapą}, \textquotedblleft{}sap, juice\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
